pkgmetadata.longdescription: Meta package for RetroArch, its support data and Libretro cores on the Nintendo Switch. RetroArch and the common overlays, shaders, database, info files and joypad autoconfiguration are always installed. The cores themselves are selected with USE flags: "recommended" pulls one well-supported core per console, "others" installs the remaining alternative cores. Enable both to install every core. Individual cores can also be installed directly without this meta package.

use.flag: Install one recommended Libretro core per console (best implementation for the Switch: Azahar, bsnes, DeSmuME, Dolphin, DOSBox-Pure, Flycast, Genesis Plus GX, Beetle PC-FX, Beetle Saturn, mGBA, Mupen64Plus-Next, Nestopia, PCSX-ReARMed, SameBoy and ScummVM).

Install the remaining Libretro cores that are alternatives or variants of the recommended ones (e.g. bnes, FCEUmm, DOSBox, Picodrive, Snes9x, VBA-M, YabaSanshiro and TwentyFortyEight). No overlap with "recommended".
